shortDescription: Manage network adapters of specified virtual machine in given vCenter infrastructure

options.name: allow_guest_os_mtu_change
options.description: Allows the guest OS to change the MTU on a SR-IOV network adapter. This option is only compatible for SR-IOV network adapters.

options.name: cluster
options.description: Name of cluster where VM belongs to.

options.name: connected
options.description: If NIC should be connected to the network.

options.name: datacenter
options.description: Datacenter the VM belongs to.

options.name: device_type
options.description: Type of virtual network device. Valid choices are - V(e1000), V(e1000e), V(pcnet32), V(vmxnet2), V(vmxnet3) (default), V(sriov), V(pvrdma).

options.name: directpath_io
options.description: Enable Universal Pass-through (UPT). Only compatible with the O(device_type=vmxnet3).

options.name: esxi_hostname
options.description: The hostname of the ESXi host where the VM belongs to.

options.name: folder
options.description: Folder location of given VM, this is only required when there's multiple VM's with the same name.

options.name: force
options.description: Force adapter creation even if an existing adapter is attached to the same network.

options.name: gather_network_info
options.description: Return information about current guest network adapters.

options.name: guest_control
options.description: Enables guest control over whether the connectable device is connected.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: label
options.description: Label of the NIC that should be altered. O(mac_address) or O(label) should be set to get the corresponding device to reconfigure. Alter the name of the network adapter.

options.name: mac_address
options.description: MAC address of the NIC that should be altered, if a MAC address is not supplied a new nic will be created. Matching is case-sensitive; use the same MAC address case as reported by VMware to target an existing NIC. If the case does not match, the module can treat the adapter as missing and attempt to create a new NIC. Required when O(state=absent).

options.name: moid
options.description: Managed Object ID of the instance to manage if known, this is a unique identifier only within a single vCenter instance. Required if O(uuid) or O(name) is not supplied.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of virtual machine Required if O(uuid) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: network_name
options.description: Name of network in vSphere. Work faster then o(vlan_id) for big infrastructure with many networks.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: physical_function_backing
options.description: If set, specifies the PCI ID of the physical function to use as backing for a SR-IOV network adapter. This option is only compatible for SR-IOV network adapters.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: pvrdma_device_protocol
options.description: The PVRDMA device protocol used. Valid choices are - V(rocev1), V(rocev2). This parameter is only used on the VM with hardware version >=14 and <= 19.

options.name: start_connected
options.description: If NIC should be connected to network on startup.

options.name: state
options.description: NIC state. When V(present), a nic will be added if a mac address or label does not previously exists or is unset. When V(absent), the O(mac_address) parameter has to be set.

options.name: switch
options.description: Name of the (dv)switch for destination network, this is only required for dvswitches.

options.name: use_instance_uuid
options.description: Whether to use the VMware instance UUID rather than the BIOS UUID.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: uuid
options.description: vm uuid Required if O(name) or O(moid) is not supplied.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.

options.name: virtual_function_backing
options.description: If set, specifies the PCI ID of the physical function to use as backing for a SR-IOV network adapter. This option is only compatible for SR-IOV network adapters.

options.name: vlan_id
options.description: VLAN id associated with the network.

options.name: wake_onlan
options.description: Enable wake on LAN.
